exposure: Pendrin expression in placental bed biopsies
cohort: 106 women who underwent cesarean delivery, including cases with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and healthy term controls
finding: Pendrin expression was significantly higher in the placental bed biopsies of women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, particularly in those with early-onset preeclampsia, suggesting a potential role for pendrin in the pathogenesis of hypertension during pregnancy.
